findings.body: The allowed scope is limited to the six implementation and test paths, but the branch still rewrites the story task decomposition and read record and changes `.factory/stories/ASK-MULTI-PLANT/story.json` plus its task record. The handoff names no necessary out-of-scope changes, and these files are not needed to deliver or test the plant-rules module. The previously reported gap therefore remains open; remove these independently changed planning and Factory files from this patch.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated out-of-scope planning and Factory changes

findings.body: This test proves that `no-plants-granted` precedes invalid-filter handling, but its remaining cases all use a valid `in` filter. It never exercises an invalid filter that also names an ungranted plant with nonempty grants—for example `eq "CHIR"`, grants `["DUB"]`, and `origin: "saved-view"`. Consequently, a regression that checks revocation before filter validity could return `plants-revoked` instead of the required `plant-filter-invalid` while every added test still passes. Add that overlapping case to prove the specified full order: no grants, invalid filter, then origin-specific revocation.
findings.title: Not done: the plant-filter refusal-order test
